content: Apple's notarization workflow: submit to notarytool, then  the returned ticket onto the artifact; if distributing inside a .dmg/.zip, the ticket must be stapled to the .app BEFORE it is placed into the final .dmg/.zip for distribution, since re-zipping after stapling is what actually embeds the stapled ticket in the shipped artifact -- stapling the inner .app and then serving an OLD zip made before stapling ships an unstapled (offline-unverifiable) copy. Matches this repo's own MEMORY.md note: 're-zip AFTER stapling'.
